scope: SPU Files keeps Keyboard/Code mode and exposes basic file actions from a context menu.

behavior.selection: Selecting JS or text prepares the editor with show=current Code mode. It never changes Keyboard into Code. Explicit preset JSON selection still applies its sound.
behavior.menu: Duplicate, Rename, Delete, New instrument, New JavaScript file and New folder. Right-click only selects the target for actions; it never applies or opens its content. Actions keep the captured target path.
behavior.duplicate: Copy working data and empty folders to an unoccupied NFC/case-fold-aware -copy path. Validate a candidate project before changing the original. Duplicating JS or JSON does not run or apply it, and keeps an existing performance.
behavior.newInstrument: Read the current authored sound and save a named .spu.json copy at the chosen free path without applying, resetting or playing it.
behavior.keyboard: Window capture intercepts menu keydown before the Synth document listener. Menu Escape closes only the menu; musical keys do not create auditions. Keyup still reaches the existing release handler. Open naming dialogs use native Escape and Enter without invoking global Stop.
behavior.dismiss: Escape, outside pointer, scroll, resize and window blur close the menu. Keyboard ContextMenu/Shift+F10 and arrow/Home/End/Enter/Space navigation are supported; coordinates are clamped inside the viewport.
